title: Please raise the volume for "Speak Readings"
body:
**Issue**
When "Speak Readings" is enabled, the volume is very low.  Raising the volume to maximum raises the effective volume.  However, it is no where near the maximum volume of the phone

**Possible solution**
Ensure that the volume of spoken readings matches that of a media played on the same phone volume setting.

**Alternative**
Unfortunately, raising the volume to max will make everything else too loud.  So, this is not a reasonable solution.

comments.body:
It turns out the specific volume that affects xDrip's "Speak Readings" is the media volume.
So, if your phone also has a ring volume and an alert volume, ensure that you adjust the media volume and not those.
